tirmidhi:2083.note: Ibn Abbas: visiting the sick (not at the time of death) and saying seven times: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you
tirmidhi:2083.grade: Sahih (Ahmad Muhammad Shakir, Al-Albani, Zubair Ali Zai)

bukhari:71.note: Muawiya; if Allah wants good for a person He gives him understanding of the religion
